surface.$description: Static containers with no states (page, card, panel, modal, menu, tooltip). The user interacts with what is inside them, never with the surface itself. Elevation order: page < default < raised.

page.$description: [Surface · static, no states] App canvas behind all content (Web page, Flutter Scaffold). Lowest emphasis. Users never interact with it; interactive elements on it use background tokens.

default.$description: [Surface · static, no states] Container for grouped content: Card, Panel, Data table container, Side navigation, each split-view pane on Tablet/Foldable. If the whole container is clickable, use background/base instead.

subtle.$description: [Surface · static, no states] Low-emphasis static block inside a page or card: page header band, grouped section, documentation home card. Not clickable; a clickable block uses background/base.

raised.$description: [Surface · static, no states] Floating container above the page: Modal, Dialog, Menu, Popover, Drawer, Bottom sheet. Always pair with an elevation token. Menu items inside it use background tokens.

inverse.$description: [Surface · static, no states] Opposite-theme container: Tooltip and Snackbar body. Text and icons on it use text/inverse and icon/inverse. For a clickable element on a dark area, use background/inverse.

background.$description: Fills of interactive elements that have states (default, hovered, pressed, disabled): buttons, inputs, chips, table/list rows, toggles, tabs. Never use for static containers; use surface. Pair each fill with the matching text/on/* and icon/on/* token.

default.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] No fill at rest. For Text button, standard Icon button, ghost Tab, link-style List item. Never use for containers.

hovered.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Hover fill of transparent elements (Web pointer only).

pressed.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Pressed fill of transparent elements; the pressed/ripple state on Tablet and Mobile.

disabled.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Disabled transparent element. Stays transparent; show the disabled state with text/disabled and icon/disabled. No hover or press effect.

default.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Default neutral fill of interactive elements: Outlined button, Text field, Select, Search, Checkbox/Radio box, clickable Card, Table row, List item. For a non-clickable card use surface/default.

subtle.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Low-emphasis neutral fill, a step darker than default: Filled text field, Neutral chip/tag, Segmented control track, Toggle track (off). For hover/press on it, layer overlay/hovered or overlay/pressed.

subtlest.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Lowest-emphasis neutral fill, almost invisible: Zebra table rows, Read-only field, Code block. Not a container; for static grouping use a surface token.

hovered.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Hover fill for base/default elements: Table row, List item, Menu item, Outlined button (Web pointer only).

pressed.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Pressed fill for base/default elements: Table row, List item, Menu item.

disabled.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Fill of disabled base elements: Text field, Select, Outlined button. No hover or press effect when disabled.

default.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Fill of a clickable element placed on a dark or brand area: button on the navy Side navigation, brand App bar, hero banner. Label uses text/role/brand. For a Tooltip/Snackbar body use surface/inverse.

hovered.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Hover fill of background/inverse elements (Web pointer only).

pressed.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Pressed fill of background/inverse elements.

default.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Bold neutral fill of an interactive element: Filled button (neutral colour), neutral Icon button. Text and icons on it use text/default and icon/default.

hovered.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Hover fill of neutral/default elements (Web pointer only).

pressed.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Pressed fill of neutral/default elements.

disabled.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Fill of a disabled neutral element. Label uses text/disabled. No hover or press effect.

default.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Bold brand fill of an interactive element: Filled button, Split button, FAB, checked Checkbox/Radio, Toggle on, Progress bar. Text and icons on it use text/on/brand and icon/on/brand. Primary actions and selection.

subtle.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Tonal brand fill: brand Chip/Tag, Lozenge, Tonal button. Text on it uses text/role/brand. Primary actions and selection.

subtlest.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Lightest brand tint: brand Alert/Banner, selected/highlighted row. Text on it uses text/role/brand or text/default. Primary actions and selection.

hovered.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Hover fill of brand/default elements (Web pointer only).

pressed.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Pressed fill of brand/default elements.

disabled.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Fill of a disabled brand element. Neutral, so the role colour disappears. Label uses text/disabled. No hover or press effect.

default.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Bold secondary fill of an interactive element: Secondary filled button, accent Badge. Text and icons on it use text/on/secondary and icon/on/secondary. Supporting actions and accents.

subtle.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Tonal secondary fill: secondary Chip/Tag, Lozenge, Tonal button. Text on it uses text/role/secondary. Supporting actions and accents.

subtlest.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Lightest secondary tint: secondary Alert/Banner, selected/highlighted row. Text on it uses text/role/secondary or text/default. Supporting actions and accents.

hovered.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Hover fill of secondary/default elements (Web pointer only).

pressed.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Pressed fill of secondary/default elements.

disabled.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Fill of a disabled secondary element. Neutral, so the role colour disappears. Label uses text/disabled. No hover or press effect.

default.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Bold success fill of an interactive element: Confirm/Approve button, Success badge, Online status dot. Text and icons on it use text/on/success and icon/on/success. Positive results, completed states, confirmations.

subtle.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Tonal success fill: success Chip/Tag, Lozenge, Tonal button. Text on it uses text/role/success. Positive results, completed states, confirmations.

subtlest.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Lightest success tint: success Alert/Banner, selected/highlighted row. Text on it uses text/role/success or text/default. Positive results, completed states, confirmations.

hovered.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Hover fill of success/default elements (Web pointer only).

pressed.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Pressed fill of success/default elements.

disabled.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Fill of a disabled success element. Neutral, so the role colour disappears. Label uses text/disabled. No hover or press effect.

default.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Bold error fill of an interactive element: Destructive button (Delete user/device), Error badge, Count badge. Text and icons on it use text/on/error and icon/on/error. Errors, failures and destructive actions.

subtle.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Tonal error fill: error Chip/Tag, Lozenge, Tonal button. Text on it uses text/role/error. Errors, failures and destructive actions.

subtlest.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Lightest error tint: error Alert/Banner, selected/highlighted row. Text on it uses text/role/error or text/default. Errors, failures and destructive actions.

hovered.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Hover fill of error/default elements (Web pointer only).

pressed.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Pressed fill of error/default elements.

disabled.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Fill of a disabled error element. Neutral, so the role colour disappears. Label uses text/disabled. No hover or press effect.

default.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Bold warning fill of an interactive element: Warning button, Warning badge (always dark text). Text and icons on it use text/on/warning and icon/on/warning. Alerts, potential risks, actions that need attention.

subtle.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Tonal warning fill: warning Chip/Tag, Lozenge, Tonal button. Text on it uses text/role/warning. Alerts, potential risks, actions that need attention.

subtlest.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Lightest warning tint: warning Alert/Banner, selected/highlighted row. Text on it uses text/role/warning or text/default. Alerts, potential risks, actions that need attention.

hovered.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Hover fill of warning/default elements (Web pointer only).

pressed.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Pressed fill of warning/default elements.

disabled.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Fill of a disabled warning element. Neutral, so the role colour disappears. Label uses text/disabled. No hover or press effect.

default.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Bold info fill of an interactive element: Info badge, In-progress step, Sync indicator. Text and icons on it use text/on/info and icon/on/info. Guidance, information, in-progress states.

subtle.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Tonal info fill: info Chip/Tag, Lozenge, Tonal button. Text on it uses text/role/info. Guidance, information, in-progress states.

subtlest.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Lightest info tint: info Alert/Banner, selected/highlighted row. Text on it uses text/role/info or text/default. Guidance, information, in-progress states.

hovered.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Hover fill of info/default elements (Web pointer only).

pressed.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Pressed fill of info/default elements.

disabled.$description: [Background · interactive, has states] Fill of a disabled info element. Neutral, so the role colour disappears. Label uses text/disabled. No hover or press effect.

default.$description: Primary text: body, headings, Button label (outlined/text), Table cell values, Input value.

subtle.$description: Secondary text: Side-nav / Navigation bar items, Input labels, Subheadings, subtle Button links, Table headers.

subtlest.$description: Tertiary text: Placeholder, Helper text, Metadata, Timestamps, Breadcrumbs, Captions. Meets 4.5:1 on every surface and base fill.

inverse.$description: Text on surface/inverse: Tooltip and Snackbar.

disabled.$description: Disabled Button label, Input value/label, Menu item. Exempt from contrast but must stay readable.

role.$description: Coloured text on neutral surfaces and on the matching background/{role}/subtle and subtlest fills.

brand.$description: Active Tab label, active Side-nav item, selected Chip label, label on background/inverse.

secondary.$description: Secondary accent text, secondary Chip label.

success.$description: Input success message, success Chip/Alert text, "Online" status label.

error.$description: Input error message, error Chip/Alert text, required asterisk.

warning.$description: Warning Chip/Lozenge text, Warning Alert text.

info.$description: Info Alert text, in-progress / workflow status label.

on.$description: Text colour placed on top of background/{role}/default, hovered and pressed fills. Always pair with that fill; never use on surfaces.

brand.$description: Text colour placed on background/brand/default, hovered and pressed fills. Always pair with that fill; never use on surfaces.

secondary.$description: Text colour placed on background/secondary/default, hovered and pressed fills. Always pair with that fill; never use on surfaces.

success.$description: Text colour placed on background/success/default, hovered and pressed fills. Always pair with that fill; never use on surfaces.

error.$description: Text colour placed on background/error/default, hovered and pressed fills. Always pair with that fill; never use on surfaces.

warning.$description: Text colour placed on background/warning/default, hovered and pressed fills. Always pair with that fill; never use on surfaces.

info.$description: Text colour placed on background/info/default, hovered and pressed fills. Always pair with that fill; never use on surfaces.

default.$description: Icons in Icon button, Toolbar, Table actions, Input trailing icon.

subtle.$description: Side-nav / Navigation bar icons, Input leading icon, Menu item icons.

subtlest.$description: Breadcrumb chevrons, Metadata icons, Helper/info hint icon.

inverse.$description: Icons inside Tooltip and Snackbar (on surface/inverse).

disabled.$description: Icons in disabled Button, Icon button, Input, Menu item.

role.$description: Coloured icon on neutral surfaces and on the matching background/{role}/subtle and subtlest fills.

brand.$description: Active Side-nav / Navigation bar icon, selected Tab icon.

success.$description: Success Alert icon, check icon, Online status icon.

error.$description: Error Alert icon, Input error icon, offline device icon.

warning.$description: Warning Alert icon, pending status icon.

info.$description: Info Alert icon, sync / in-progress icon.

on.$description: Icon colour placed on top of background/{role}/default, hovered and pressed fills. Always pair with that fill; never use on surfaces.

brand.$description: Icon colour placed on background/brand/default, hovered and pressed fills. Always pair with that fill; never use on surfaces.

secondary.$description: Icon colour placed on background/secondary/default, hovered and pressed fills. Always pair with that fill; never use on surfaces.

success.$description: Icon colour placed on background/success/default, hovered and pressed fills. Always pair with that fill; never use on surfaces.

error.$description: Icon colour placed on background/error/default, hovered and pressed fills. Always pair with that fill; never use on surfaces.

warning.$description: Icon colour placed on background/warning/default, hovered and pressed fills. Always pair with that fill; never use on surfaces.

info.$description: Icon colour placed on background/info/default, hovered and pressed fills. Always pair with that fill; never use on surfaces.

default.$description: Decorative separation: cards, tables, dividers. Not for control boundaries.

inverse.$description: Outlines and focus ring of controls placed on brand or inverse surfaces.

input.$description: Boundaries of controls that need 3:1 (inputs, checkboxes, outline icon buttons). Merges form/default, control-accessible, icon-button/outline.

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring. FIX: was primary/200 (2.58:1 on white, below 3:1).

pressed.$description: State layer over a non-filled control on press.

hovered.$description: State layer over a non-filled control (tonal, outlined, text) on hover. Placed above the control's own fill.

shadow.$description: Shadow colors used inside elevation tokens only.
